journey.name: Focus compatibility self-test
journey.description: Verify permission gating, controlled notification capture, quiet release, and Box persistence on one Android device.

actions.action: Install the current debug APK and grant Notification Access, Do Not Disturb access, exact alarms, and post notifications.
Open nonoti and verify that the four platform capabilities and Automatic Zen Rule are ready while compatibility self-test is not ready.
Tap Compatibility self-test, then tap Run 30-second test.
Verify that nonoti shows Focus active while the test runs and that Box content is inaccessible.
Wait for quiet release to finish, then verify that the compatibility test can be confirmed.
Confirm the compatibility test and verify that Start now becomes enabled.
Open Box and verify that the captured compatibility notification is present.
Verify that the nonoti Automatic Zen Rule is not active and exactly one Focus summary notification is present.
